tools.name: getDiagnostics
tools.description: Get the errors, warnings and other diagnostics VS Code currently shows in its Problems panel, including those for unsaved changes in open editors. Returns a JSON array with one entry per file. Pass `uri` to check one file, or omit it to get every file VS Code currently has diagnostics for. Many language extensions only analyze open files, so a missing file or an empty list can mean the file has not been checked, not that it is clean.

uri.description: file:// URI of the one file to check. Omit to get every file VS Code currently has diagnostics for.
